summary: Iteration 17: Full end-to-end integration test (backend + frontend) of Mulyatani after sample-product removal and new WhatsApp receipt feature. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a 1821-line monolith — split into routers (products, pos, purchases, payroll, attendance, reports, settings) for maintainability.
No rate-limit / retry handling in frontend for preview ingress 429 — rapid-fire navigation can throttle; already-documented in iter_16.
WhatsAppReceipt.jsx is clean and correct; toWaNumber handles '0' prefix only — numbers that start with '+62' or '62' pass through correctly.
Transaction edit/delete properly reconciles stock via _restore_sale_items + _apply_sale_items. Verified by API test.
Report query params lack defaults (daily/monthly/yearly require date/year/month) — frontend must always pass; worth considering FastAPI default=today.
